agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 9, 2020 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

CONSENT CALENDAR
6.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of May 26, 2020.
6.1 Minutes of May 26, 2020
6.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 9, 2020 in the total amount of $1,635,028.33.
6.2 Warrant Register
6.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-07, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR LA MIRADA BOULEVARD FROM LEFFINGWELL ROAD TO ALONDRA BOULEVARD, AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-08, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO BEACH BOULEVARD – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Marina Landscape, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
6.3 CIP No. 2017-07
6.4
AMENDED AND RESTATED GROUND LEASE AGREEMENT WITH STC ONE LLC - It is recommended the City Council approve the Amended and Restated Ground Lease Agreement between the City of La Mirada and STC ONE LLC, subject to the lease agreement terms recommended by staff, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements on behalf of the City.
6.4 Agreement with STC ONE LLC
6.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MARCH 2020 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending March 2020.
6.5 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.
PUBLIC HEARING
7.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-16 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 20-16 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates in the City of La Mirada.
7.1 Resolution No. 20-16
7.2
RESOLUTION NO. 20-17 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 20-17 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget.
7.2 Resolution No. 20-17
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-18 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 - It is recommended the City Council select the California Per Capita Personal Income percentage change from the preceding year as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2020-21; select the growth of the County as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2020-21; and adopt Resolution No. 20-18 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2020-21 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
8.1 Resolution No. 20-18
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 20-19 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 19-19 AND RESOLUTION NO. 19-25 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-19 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment, and superseding Resolution No. 19-19 and Resolution No. 19-25.
8.2 Resolution No. 20-19
